title.zh: 酶 · 生物体内的催化剂
title.en: Enzymes · Catalysts of the Living World

desc.zh: 酶用一个形状合适的“口袋”把底物拉到一起，让反应在体温下就能飞快进行：从锁钥配合，到饱和、温度、pH 和抑制剂。
desc.en: An enzyme pulls substrates together in a pocket of the right shape so reactions run fast at body temperature: from lock-and-key fit to saturation, temperature, pH and inhibitors.
